sus: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/modules/gdscript/gdscript_cache.cpp#L385

I think we need to wait here until the reload actually finishes? It seems like it just returns immediately when you call `reload()` while it's already reloading.

This happens because the original loading task (objective_list.tscn) loads `objective_list.gd` which then has `preload("current-square.svg")` which completes, and then runs the next task (on the same thread) instead of returning and allowing the original `load()` to complete.

```
GDScript::reload()
GDScriptCache::get_full_script()
ResourceFormatLoaderGDScript::load()
ResourceLoader::_load() => "res://objective_list.gd"
...
ResourceFormatLoaderText::load() => "res://objective_list.tscn"
...
ResourceFormatLoaderText::load() => "res://objective_list_parent.tscn"
...
WorkerThreadPool::_process_task()
WorkerThreadPool::_wait_collaboratively()
WorkerThreadPool::wait_for_task_completion()
ResourceLoader::_load_complete_inner()
ResourceLoader::_load_complete()
ResourceLoader::load() ->  preload("res://images/current-square.svg")
GDScriptAnalyzer::reduce_preload()
...
GDScriptAnalyzer::resolve_interface()
GDScriptAnalyzer::analyze()
GDScript::reload()
GDScriptCache::get_full_script()
ResourceFormatLoaderGDScript::load() => "res://objective_list.gd"
```

res://objective_list.tscn => res://objective_list.gd => res://objective_list_parent.tscn => res://objective_list.tscn => res://objective_list.gd
